headline: Emory & Henry overtake Catawba at the top
dek: Coker ended Catawba's unbeaten season with a win at Catawba, while Emory & Henry beat Tusculum on the same day to go a point clear. They are now the only side in the conference without a defeat.
displaced_by: truth: the dek's 'on Wednesday' now reads as yesterday from a Thursday page; the same story stands with the weekday removed

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Emory & Henry have scored 24 and conceded five: the side now top of the table has got there by keeping goals out, not by scoring them.

wire.line: Catawba's first defeat, at home to Coker, has handed Emory & Henry the top of the table.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and the rest Emory & Henry's, the latest their home match with Palm Beach Atlantic in September.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Emory & Henry's home draw with Lenoir-Rhyne on Saturday was their third of the season; they have won eight and lost none.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Catawba's win over Mars Hill on Saturday was their thirteenth of the season, against two draws and one defeat.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Anderson's win over Lincoln Memorial on Saturday was their tenth of the season, against four draws and two defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Coker's draw at Carson-Newman on Saturday was their second of the season, beside seven wins and five defeats.

last_match.line: Emory & Henry have yet to lose this season; Lenoir-Rhyne are the first side to take a draw from them since September.

next_match.line: Catawba won at Anderson in October; Anderson have won each of their last three.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
